prediction_text: Hillary Clinton wins the 2016 election, and what decides it is the email/Foundation controversy: the tarot reading points to Clinton prevailing narrowly on 8 November 2016, with the late email controversy as the decisive drag that makes the margin far smaller than mid-summer polls suggested — damaging but not reversing her win.
basis:
Card bears no tradition field; decided by genre: tarot election reading (WP-007 Manhattan tarot reader, August 2016; Clinton email controversy and Foundation already public controversies on the card).
The question asks both winner and deciding factor; the card's own setting foregrounds the two Clinton controversies, so they are named as the deciding variable. Direction follows the August polling lead the reading was given against; the controversies are read as margin-cutters, not outcome-flippers, and that distinction is stated explicitly.
